Name: Supply Hay Stack Silo Replacement for Content Patcher
Author: SlyAceZeta
Description:
This mod is a conversion for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1519]Hay Silo[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/48166143]Flor3nce2456[/url]. It changes the Silo to look like a stack of hay with some supplies nearby, and when it's snowing, the hay and supplies will have some snow on top as well.

If you want a taller stack of hay with no supplies, check out this mod instead: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3652]Tall Hay Stack Silo Replacement for Content Patcher[/url]

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Install Content Patcher[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Supply Hay Stack Silo
Manifest.Description: Replaces the Silo with a stack of hay and miscellaneous supplies! Originally by Flor3nce2456, ported to Content Patcher by SlyCooperFan1.
Manifest.Author: SlyCooperFan1
